new_result.statement: For a rank-two residual S=VDV^T with max physical range leverage rho<1/2, some physical cut has det(V_I^TV_I)det(V_J^TV_J)>=(1-2rho)/16 and E_2(B)>=(mu_1mu_2)^2(1-2rho)/16. The same cut has range leverage <=16rho/(1-2rho); if rho<=1/34 it automatically satisfies the q=1 determinant gate and E_2(B)>=(mu_1mu_2)^2/17.

rank3_corollary.scope: Exact rank three, a nonzero original scalar pivot a_i, and maximum Schur projected leverage <=1/34.

first_unproved_step: Heavy-Schur-range / tiny-or-zero-pivot aggregate routing: either produce a large aggregate E_2/E_3 currency with a usable scalar square or close by a product-preserving hyperbolic/bilinear bank mechanism.
